                        new_cost = route_cost(ri_new) + route_cost(rj_new)
                        base_cost = base_i_cost + base_j_cost
                        delta = new_cost - base_cost
                        if best is None or delta < best[0]:
                            best = (delta, i, pos, j, ins_pos)

        if best is None:
            return False
        if best[0] >= 0:
            return False

        _, i, pos, j, ins_pos = best
        node = routes[i][pos]
        routes[i].pop(pos)
        if not routes[i]:
            routes.pop(i)
            # if i < j, target index shifts by -1 after pop
            if i < j:
                j -= 1
        routes[j].insert(ins_pos, node)
        return True

    # run bounded number of exact relocate improvements
    for _ in range(45):
        if not inter_relocate(routes):
            break

    # final cleanup
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    return routes
